description: The pie chart, titled "Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM)," illustrates the proportional distribution of token routing across three distinct categories. The largest segment is colored green, accounting for 94.5% of the total, though it lacks a specific text label aside from a small grey rectangle positioned in the bottom right area. The remaining two slices are visually emphasized by being exploded, or slightly offset, from the main body of the chart. These include a red slice labeled "LLM" representing 3.9%, and a smaller blue slice labeled "EDGE_P2P" representing 1.6%. The chart does not feature a separate legend; instead, the text labels for the smaller categories are positioned just outside their respective slices, while the percentage values are displayed directly inside each segment. Visually, the two smallest, exploded segments are grouped together in the upper left quadrant of the chart, contrasting with the single large green segment that dominates the rest of the area.
